body:
RELUCTANT SORCERER
CR 9

XP 6,400
Medium humanoid (human)
Init +3, Senses Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+3 Dex, +6 armor, +2 shield)
hp 77 (14d6 +28)
Fort +6, Ref +7, Will +10

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee spiked mace +11/+6 (1d6+4 bludgeoning)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 11, Wis 12, Cha 22
Base Atk +10; CMB +11, CMD 24

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Uncontrollable Magic (Su)

The reluctant sorcerer has long-suppressed magic, and if the circle is destroyed or made ineffectual, it will be unleashed every turn. Roll 1d4 to determine which spell he unwillingly casts. The save DCs are all 20.

Chain lightning
Horrid wilting
Prismatic spray
Sunburst

None of these spells will harm the reluctant sorcerer, but he does not choose the targets. The spell targets the nearest creature if a target is selected. In the case of chain lightning, it will continue to strike the nearest creature until all targets are exhausted. These spells do not count against the reluctant sorcerer’s turn.
